name: STM Montréal Train Pack
author: Haeffound
description:
# Montréal STM Train Pack Subway Builder STM-Pack is a mod for the game Subway Builder that adds trains from the Montréal Metropolis. This pack change base-game vehicles only. This pack also is fully compatible with all the current Beta feature (acceleration curve, diesel train, tram, doors, catenary…). Light Metro is not changed because it's already the basegame vehicle (just changed the name). Only use underground for MPM-10 and MR-73 because of the snow. They are compatible with each others tracks. You won't be able to construct them above -4, don't try, the blueprint won't be buildable. #### Métro (3)
